title: Kartu di Kantong Belakang
genre: Toba Batak hasapi folk-pop (hasapi, sulim and garantung)
subject: In Balige a woman buys a secondhand library book at a clearance sale and finds the same borrower's name on the due-date card of every book she picks, so she starts borrowing everything he borrowed and slips a note into the last card
caption: Toba Batak folk-pop love song. A hasapi two-string lute plays a steady plucked ostinato, a sulim bamboo flute answers between lines, a garantung wooden xylophone doubles the melody softly, a nylon-string acoustic guitar strums light chords, no drum kit. Dry wooden room sound, soft plate reverb, unhurried. A female lead sings in a warm clear mid-range with a gentle Batak ornament on held notes. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, A minor. Tender, curious mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads, no big drum fills.
lyrics:
[Intro - hasapi, sulim]

[Verse 1]
Di bazar buku bekas perpustakaan Balige
Kubeli novel tua seribu rupiah
Di kantong belakangnya ada kartu tanggal
Satu nama berulang, Tigor Sihombing

[Pre-Chorus]
Buku kedua, namanya sama
Buku ketiga, tulisannya sama

[Chorus]
Siapa kau, Tigor, yang baca duluan
Kau tandai halaman yang kutandai juga
Kupinjam semua yang pernah kau pinjam
Mungkin di rak mana kita berpapasan

[Verse 2]
Ibu pustakawan tersenyum, ia tahu orangnya
Katanya Tigor mengajar di Laguboti
Kutulis satu surat, kuselip di kartu
Tanggal kembali kuisi minggu depan

[Chorus]
Siapa kau, Tigor, yang baca duluan
Hari ini kubalik halaman yang sama
Kupinjam satu lagi, kuselip suratku
Semoga kau yang membukanya berikutnya

[Outro - sulim, hasapi]
Tanggal kembali, minggu depan
Mungkin kita bertemu di situ
